Research question: Which social media channel drives the highest local discovery for youth in tier-2 Tamil Nadu cities like Trichy?
Observation: Instagram Reels featuring aesthetic ambiance, relatable student exam/assignment humor, and food close-ups have 3-5x higher organic local reach than static feed posts.
Source: Meta Creator & Local Business Benchmarks (Tamil Nadu regional insights)
Marketing opportunity: Make short-form vertical video (Reels) the primary top-of-funnel engine, collaborating with college micro-creators from NITT and Bishop Heber.

Research question: How do students make the final decision to visit a new cafe once discovered online?
Observation: 82% of students verify the spot on Google Maps to check recent reviews, photos of actual seating/menu, price transparency, and exact distance.
Source: Google Business Profile Local Consumer Research
Marketing opportunity: Optimize Google Business Profile with high-res photos of power sockets, the complete student combo menu with transparent pricing, and 4.5+ star review velocity.

Research question: What conversion incentive is most effective to trigger a first physical walk-in?
Observation: A low-barrier, time-bound introductory offer (e.g., 'Free Cookie with Iced Brew' or 'Flat ₹149 Student Combo') eliminates perceived financial risk.
Source: National Restaurant Association India (NRAI) Youth Dining Trends
Marketing opportunity: Deploy a 'First-Timer Campus Pass' or ₹149 Study Fuel combo redeemable upon showing a college ID or scanning an Instagram QR promo.

Research question: What retention mechanism works best for college students without needing heavy mobile app downloads?
Observation: Students resist downloading heavy dedicated apps for a single cafe; lightweight WhatsApp-based stamp cards or phone-number loyalty have 4x higher repeat adoption.
Source: Mobile Marketing Association (India) Retail Case Studies
Marketing opportunity: Implement a frictionless WhatsApp-based digital stamp card: Buy 4 coffees, get the 5th brew free, plus an instant birthday treat perk.
